target_problem: comparison-free range avoidance via polynomial candidate lists or support-incidence surplus certificates for NC0_3-Avoid[N,N+1]
conditional_implication: Polynomial candidate-list cardinality is not the stretch-one bottleneck: support-conditioned lists of size at most 8(N+1)+1 and circuit-oblivious lists of size O(N log N) exist nonuniformly. In addition, if a positive-surplus support-incidence component has rho inputs, an actual avoided output is constructible in O(2^rho poly(N)) time. A general FP^NP support-conditioned list constructor would yield NC0_3-Avoid[N,N+1] in FP^NP via NP range-membership queries; truncation would reach the published Gajulapalli-Golovnev-Nagargoje-Saraogi lower-bound-transfer regime. V96 does not obtain that general constructor and therefore does not trigger the published consequence.
frontier_reason: V96 gives an instance-parameterized constructive branch and an internal compression/uniformization barrier, but no all-instance complexity improvement. The published rigidity/circuit-lower-bound consequence remains conditional on a uniform FP^NP bridge that V96 does not provide.

target_row.required_complexity: a polynomial-time or FP^NP constructive universal list, a guarantee that the positive-surplus component parameter rho is small, or a different comparison-free avoided-output policy
target_row.named_baseline: Huang-Li-Zhong ITCS 2026 local algorithm O(N*2^(N/2)) for k=3

bridge_lemmas.name: a fixed ordered support pattern S represents at most 2^{sum_i 2^{|S_i|}} locality-three circuits
every support pattern has a nonuniform universal candidate list of size at most 1+sum_i 2^{|S_i|} <= 8(N+1)+1
all stretch-one NC0_3 circuits admit one N-only nonuniform universal list of size O(N log N)
every list of at most 3 floor(log2(N/3)) targets can be embedded in a monotone three-local OR circuit
the common-fixed-triple support family has exact universal-list number nine
the support-incidence decomposition always contains a positive-surplus component at exact stretch one
enumerating the smallest positive-surplus component yields a comparison-free O(2^rho poly(N)) avoided-output algorithm
an FP^NP support-conditioned universal-list constructor yields FP^NP stretch-one range avoidance via NP range-membership queries
stretch-one range avoidance transfers to every larger output length by truncating to N+1 coordinates and extending an absent prefix
a polynomial-time or FP^NP general support-conditioned universal-list constructor is obtained
rho(C)=O(log N) is guaranteed for every stretch-one NC0_3 circuit
the Huang-Li-Zhong O(N*2^(N/2)) all-instance runtime is improved

current_gap: Small positive-surplus components are now solved uniformly and comparison-free, while polynomial universal lists exist nonuniformly for every support pattern. The residual hard support regime has all positive-surplus components superlogarithmic, potentially one large connected component; there the successful universal candidates are still not uniformly extracted.
result_obtained: Support-conditioned O(N) and circuit-oblivious O(N log N) nonuniform universal-list theorems, an explicit Omega(log N) lower bound against monotone 3-local OR circuits, exact common-triple list number nine, a constructive O(2^rho poly(N)) surplus-component avoider, and a uniformization-to-FP^NP transfer theorem.
closed_route: treating polynomial candidate-list cardinality itself as the main obstruction, and the entire support-disconnected regime with a logarithmic-size positive-surplus component
surviving_route: uniform extraction inside large positive-surplus components using separators or restricted support structure, or an obstruction for weaker certificate generators
stop_rule: Do not spend V97 optimizing the nonuniform O(N log N) list size. Attack the large positive-surplus component directly: obtain a uniform constructor on a nontrivial separator/support family, prove an obstruction, or give another end-to-end comparison-free certificate policy. Do not relabel the old exact-count width machinery as a new result.
external_validation_target: Guruswami-Lyu-Wang APPROX/RANDOM 2022 explicit range-avoidance hitting sets; Huang-Li-Zhong ITCS 2026 stretch-one algorithm; Gajulapalli-Golovnev-Nagargoje-Saraogi APPROX/RANDOM 2023 NC0_3-Avoid lower-bound transfer; prior-art review for universal-list/shattering and surplus-component formulations
